Police JRFT

Job-related fitness test

POLICE FITNESS TEST

At a glance

The College of Policing publishes a job-related fitness standard based on a 15-metre multi-stage shuttle run. Some specialist roles have different standards.

FEATURED ACTIVITY15 m shuttle runLevel 5.4 for officers requiring personal safety training

What the test includes

  • 15 m multi-stage fitness test

Some programmes include more than the activities listed here.

Test protocol and standards

The College of Policing job-related fitness test in England and Wales uses the 15 m multi-stage shuttle protocol. General personal safety training uses level 5.4; specialist roles may have higher standards.

Official information checked 2026-11-24. Confirm current requirements with the test publisher.

ParameterPublished standard
Lane length15 m
General personal safety trainingLevel 5, shuttle 4
Specialist rolesCheck the role-specific table

Scoring and scope

One length of the 15 m course is one shuttle. Level 5.4 is level five, shuttle four, not a decimal speed or a result on the 20 m test.

How to prepare

Independent training guidance, not official test instructions. Scale sessions to your current capacity and recover between demanding efforts.

  • Measure the lane and use the correct 15 m audio. Practise reaching the line and turning smoothly without sprinting the early levels.
  • Build aerobic capacity with easy runs or brisk walks and gradually add brief shuttle intervals.
  • Retest with the same surface, audio and footwear after adequate recovery; stop at the applicable standard or according to assessor instructions.

Common mistakes

  • Using a 20 m beep-test recording.
  • Starting too fast, turning early, or treating the general standard as sufficient for every specialist role.

What to log

Record protocol length, final level and shuttle, surface and whether the required standard was reached.

Avoid repeated maximal tests and sudden load increases. Stop if pain, dizziness or unusual symptoms occur; use qualified supervision where appropriate.

Official test instructions

The organisation running the test is the best place to check the latest rules and requirements.

Visit College of Policing
REFERENCE

College of Policing. (n.d.). Job-related fitness standards. https://www.college.police.uk/support-forces/health-safety-welfare/job-related-fitness-standards

Worth knowing

  • Level 5.4 means completing four shuttles at level five at the required pace.
  • Check the standard for your actual role; do not substitute a 20 m shuttle protocol.
